answer: Mooring-bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity moors at one kernel anchor in the public garden, locking a keyed 70-credit bond. Auditors replay the garden each epoch: one kernel, one identity; a hollow identity without signed work cannot renew, losing its bond. Rented moorings burn both bonds. First fake costs 38, k-th 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 and lock 70,000 vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent moors once, pays 38, keeps bond and share.
